stem.text: The graph shows how a physical quantity varies with time.

stem.alt: Graph of quantity against time with origin marked 0. The curve falls from a high value to the time axis, stays level, dips sharply below the axis, then rises back to the axis.

stem.text: Which event could best be represented by the graph?

A.text: the acceleration of a firework rising to a maximum height and falling to the ground

B.text: the acceleration of a skydiver leaving an aircraft, falling, opening a parachute and falling to the ground

C.text: the speed of a javelin as it leaves an athlete’s hand, falls and sinks into the ground

D.text: the speed of a high jump athlete leaving the ground, jumping over a bar and descending to the ground
